# Maple

Maple is a desktop and mobile theme with animations, visual components and an embedded Maple Mono monospace font. Colors, layout and backgrounds are customizable through Style Settings, and a built-in Alternate Checkbox syntax provides richer todo states.

![Maple screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/subframe7536/obsidian-theme-maple/HEAD/img/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Maple"
    author: "subframe7536"
    repo:   "subframe7536/obsidian-theme-maple"
    slug:   "maple"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/maple"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/subframe7536/obsidian-theme-maple"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/subframe7536/obsidian-theme-maple/HEAD/img/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a sleek, modern desktop and mobile theme with graceful animations, visual components, and an embedded Maple Mono monospace font. Customize colors, layout and backgrounds via Style Settings and use built-in Alternate Checkbox syntax for richer todo states."
}
```
